name: uBlock Origin
title: uBlock Origin: free AdGuard alternative
hook: AdGuard charges you thirty bucks a year to block ads. This app does it for free.

features.intro: It wipes the ads off every site.
features.say: Ads, trackers, popups, even malware sites.
The popup shows you how much it blocked on every page.
You can switch on extra filter lists to block even more.

install: Download from your browser's add-on store
install_line: It runs in Firefox, even on Android, and in Opera. Just add it free from the add-on store.
caption:
AdGuard charges $29.88/year to block ads. uBlock Origin does it for free 🛡️

✅ Blocks ads, trackers, popups and malware sites
✅ Popup shows what it blocked on every page
✅ Switch on extra filter lists to block even more
✅ No subscription, no account, 100% free

💻 Firefox (computer + Android) · Opera
ℹ️ Heads up: Chrome and Edge are dropping the full uBlock Origin, so there you only get the lighter uBlock Origin Lite. AdGuard's $29.88 is its regular yearly Personal price
